title: bureau.credit_record.reported (CREDIT_BUREAU)
description: One event = one row of bureau.csv (original column names and values are kept in payload). event_time: Submission time - 5 minutes (the credit bureau returns its report during underwriting).

event_id.description: BLAKE2b-128 of source_table + natural key. Deterministic -> use it for de-duplication.

schema_version.description: SemVer. A MAJOR change -> new topic (.v2).

event_time.description: Business time (simulated, +07:00). Submission time - 5 minutes (the credit bureau returns its report during underwriting).

produced_at.description: Wall-clock time the producer sent the event.

customer_id.description: SK_ID_CURR of the customer; also the Kafka message key.

SK_ID_CURR.description: ID of loan in our sample - one loan in our sample can have 0,1,2 or more related previous credits in credit bureau

CREDIT_ACTIVE.description: Status of the Credit Bureau (CB) reported credits

CREDIT_CURRENCY.description: Recoded currency of the Credit Bureau credit

DAYS_CREDIT.description: How many days before current application did client apply for Credit Bureau credit
DAYS_CREDIT.x-note: time only relative to the application

CREDIT_DAY_OVERDUE.description: Number of days past due on CB credit at the time of application for related loan in our sample

DAYS_CREDIT_ENDDATE.description: Remaining duration of CB credit (in days) at the time of application in Home Credit
DAYS_CREDIT_ENDDATE.x-note: time only relative to the application

DAYS_ENDDATE_FACT.description: Days since CB credit ended at the time of application in Home Credit (only for closed credit)
DAYS_ENDDATE_FACT.x-note: time only relative to the application

AMT_CREDIT_MAX_OVERDUE.description: Maximal amount overdue on the Credit Bureau credit so far (at application date of loan in our sample)

CNT_CREDIT_PROLONG.description: How many times was the Credit Bureau credit prolonged

AMT_CREDIT_SUM.description: Current credit amount for the Credit Bureau credit

AMT_CREDIT_SUM_DEBT.description: Current debt on Credit Bureau credit

AMT_CREDIT_SUM_LIMIT.description: Current credit limit of credit card reported in Credit Bureau

AMT_CREDIT_SUM_OVERDUE.description: Current amount overdue on Credit Bureau credit

CREDIT_TYPE.description: Type of Credit Bureau credit (Car, cash,...)
x-observed-values: Loan for purchase of shares (margin lending)
Loan for the purchase of equipment

DAYS_CREDIT_UPDATE.description: How many days before loan application did last information about the Credit Bureau credit come
DAYS_CREDIT_UPDATE.x-note: time only relative to the application

AMT_ANNUITY.description: Annuity of the Credit Bureau credit
